title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.0.7
description:
• 🛡️ 100% Guaranteed Apify Live UID Verification: Integrated official Apify FB UID Check Actor (ratulislam/fb-uid-check) with live token authentication. Every created account is tested directly against Facebook's servers with zero error margin.
• 👤 Exact Profile Liveness Discrimination: Apify Actor validates both og:title metadata and fb://profile/ deep-link headers to separate genuine live accounts (e.g. Ethan Brown, Robert Anderson) from dead/checkpointed ones.
• ⚙️ In-App Apify Token Configuration & Live Test: Dedicated settings panel in both Settings & Updates tab and Studio Settings dialog to manage your Apify API Token and run instant live connection health checks.
• 🔄 Resilient Multi-Tier Fallback: If network to Apify is ever unreachable, the engine gracefully falls back to authenticated session /me and checkpoint inspection without interrupting batch execution.
